text:
[issue by HyperMan19680]
### Context

Yeah, whenever I place a package down in-world or on a conveyer belt, my game crashes to desktop.

### Crash Report

https://mclo.gs/2P3sB4x

[comment by VoidLeech (collaborator)]
This is caused by another mod trying to add synced data to entities in the improper way (similarly to #8287 but it’ll be a different mod here), try a binary search to find the offending mod, it is a simple process:

1) Remove half your mods
2) Try to reproduce the issue
3) If you can, repeat from 1); otherwise, remove all mods, add back the mods removed in 1), then repeat from 1)
